id.description: Optional. The service generates a stable ID when omitted.

driver.description: An installed adapter name or Python module:Class. Read /v1/adapters.

config.description: Driver-specific connection settings and named operations.

allowed_operations.description: Operation name patterns available on this instrument, such as read_* or set.ch1.*; identify stays available. Omit to allow all.

timeout.description: Maximum operation duration in seconds; default 300.

startup_timeout.description: Driver startup and description timeout in seconds; default 30.

cancel_timeout.description: Time to finish cancellation before the SDK process ends; default 2.

calibration.description: Calibration of this instrument. Operations record its id and any uncertainty listed for them.

date.description: ISO date or time with offset

valid_until.description: ISO date (ends 23:59:59 UTC) or time with offset

uncertainty.description: Operation name to uncertainty, for example {"value": 0.02, "unit": "V", "coverage_factor": 2}
